## 00. Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Helper functions

```{r}

clean_names = function(d){
  d %>%
    mutate(
      sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,
                               c('pairs','dt','cpe','pp','sc'), 
                               c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5'
                               ))
    ) %>%
    mutate(domain = factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
    mutate(sample = factor(sample,c('Sample 1','Sample 2', 'Sample 3', 'Sample 4',
                                    'Sample 5')))
}

```

#### Custom theme for plots

```{r include =FALSE}
library(extrafont)
loadfonts(device='win')

my_theme2 <- function(){
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
      , legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1))
      , legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1))
      , axis.text = element_text(size = rel(1.1), color = "#262626",family='Corbel')
      , axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2),family='Corbel')
      , plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), hjust = .5)
      , plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1.2), hjust = .5)
      , strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.1), color = "black",family='Corbel')
      , strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour='black',size=rel(1.2))
    )
}

b5_pal = c('EXT' = '#F07F09',
           'AGR'= '#9F2936',
           'CON'= '#1B587C',
           'NEU'= '#604878',
           'OPE'='#33CAFF',
           'No Match'='darkgray')

std_pal = c(
  'high'= 1,
  'low'= .5,
  'both/none'= .25
)
```

## 01. Basic descriptives

### Ns passing exclusions, etc

```{r}
#how many ppl passed our initial ESM-based exclusions?
ns_esm = raw_esm0 %>%
  select(sample,domain,SID) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(sample,domain) %>%
  tally()  %>%
  mutate(version = 'esm.based')

ns_attr = attr0 %>%
  select(version,sample,domain,parameter,SID) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(version,sample,domain,parameter) %>%
  tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #remove parameter bc ns are identical for strength and location 
  select(-parameter) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(version = paste0('attr.',version))
  # pivot_wider(names_from=domain,values_from=c(strict,chill),names_vary = 'slowest',values_fill=0)

ns_all = rbind(ns_esm,ns_attr)%>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,c('esm.based','attr.chill','attr.strict'))) %>%
  arrange(sample,domain,version) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=c(domain,version),values_from=n,
              values_fill=0,names_vary='slowest')
```

How many domains complete per person?

```{r}
n_complete = attr0 %>%
  select(version,sample,SID,domain) %>%
  unique() %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  group_by(version,sample,SID) %>%
  mutate(n_complete = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(version,sample) %>%
  mutate(mean_complete = mean(n_complete,na.rm=T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(version,sample,SID,n_complete,mean_complete) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(version,sample,n_complete) %>%
  mutate(n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(version,sample,n_complete,n,mean_complete) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(n_complete=paste0(n_complete,'.compl')) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=c(version,n_complete),values_from=c(n,mean_complete))
```

### ESM means + SDs

```{r}
pomp <- function(x, mini = 1, maxi = 5) ((x - mini)/(maxi- mini))*10

#get intraindividual means and sds
esm_means.i = raw_esm %>%
  group_by(sample,SID,domain) %>%
  summarise(imean = mean(score,na.rm=T),isd=sd(score,na.rm=T)) 

esm_means = esm_means.i %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  group_by(sample,domain) %>%
  summarise(
    mean.m = mean(imean,na.rm=T)
    ,sd.m = sd(imean,na.rm=T)
    ,min.m = min(imean,na.rm=T)
    ,max.m=max(imean,na.rm=T)
    ,mean.sd = mean(isd,na.rm=T)
    ,sd.sd = sd(isd,na.rm=T)
    ,min.sd = min(isd,na.rm=T)
    ,max.sd = max(isd,na.rm=T)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean.m:max.sd),~round(.x,2))) %>%
  mutate(m.mean_sd = sprintf('%s (%s)',mean.m,sd.m),
         sd.mean_sd = sprintf('%s (%s)',mean.sd,sd.sd)) %>%
  select(sample,domain,m.mean_sd,min.m,max.m,sd.mean_sd,min.sd,max.sd)

# write_csv(esm_means,'../04-results/tables/descriptives/suppD1-esm-descriptives.csv')
```

```{r}
attr.means = attr %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  group_by(sample,domain,parameter) %>%
  rename(val = mean) %>%
  summarise(
    mean=mean(val,na.rm=T)
    ,sd=sd(val,na.rm=T)
    ,min=min(val,na.rm=T)
    ,max=max(val,na.rm=T)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean:max), ~round(.x,2)))


attr.means.tb = attr.means %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf('%s (%s)',mean,sd)) %>%
  select(sample,domain,parameter,mean_sd,min,max) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=parameter,values_from=c(mean_sd,min,max),names_vary = 'slowest') 

# write_csv(attr.means.tb,"../04-results/tables/descriptives/suppD2-attr-descriptives.csv")
```

#### Combine together

```{r}
all_means = attr.means.tb %>%
  inner_join(esm_means)
```

### Breakdown of trait coding results

```{r include=FALSE}
scored_traits = read_csv('../02-data/02-clean-data/traits/central-traits-scored-poles.csv') %>%
  inner_join(attr_ids)

tallies = scored_traits %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(n=n_distinct(SID)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample,domain) %>%
  mutate(
    ct = sum(is_central),
    high = sum(ct_high),
    low = sum(ct_low)
  ) %>%
  select(sample,domain,ct,high,low,n) %>%
  unique() %>%
  clean_names()

no_traits = scored_traits %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain,is_central) %>%
  group_by(sample,SID) %>%
  summarise(max=max(is_central)) %>%
  filter(max == 0) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  tally() %>%
  rename(no_matches=n) %>%
  mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5'))) %>%
  arrange(sample)

all_trait_tallies = tallies %>% merge(no_traits,by='sample') %>%
  select(sample,domain,high,low,ct,no_matches,n) %>%
  rename(Sample=sample,Domain=domain,`Central (Either)`=ct,
         `Central (High)`=high,`Central (Low)`=low,`No Matches`=no_matches,`Total N`=n) %>%
  arrange(Sample,Domain)
```

#### Figure for main manuscript

```{r}
no_traits2 = all_trait_tallies %>%
  select(Sample,Domain,`No Matches`,`Total N`) %>%
  unique() %>%
  rename(sample=Sample,domain=Domain,no_match=`No Matches`,n=`Total N`) %>%
  mutate(pct=(no_match/n)*100) %>%
  select(sample,pct) %>%
  mutate(domain='no_match',standing='both/none') %>%
  unique()

tallies_plt0 = tallies %>%
  mutate(both=ct-(high+low)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(high,low,both),names_to='standing',values_to='count') %>%
  mutate(standing = ifelse(standing=='both','both/none',standing)) %>%
  mutate(pct=(count/n)*100) %>%
  select(sample,domain,standing,pct) %>%
  bind_rows(no_traits2) %>%
  mutate(domain=str_replace(domain,'no_match','No Match')) %>%
  mutate(domain=factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE','No Match'))) %>%
  mutate(standing=factor(standing,c('high','low','both/none')))

```

plotting function

```{r}
tmp = tallies_plt0 %>% filter(sample =='Sample 1') %>% filter (pct != 0)

tallies_plt = tallies_plt0 %>%
  filter(pct != 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=domain,y=pct,fill=domain,alpha=standing)) +
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(),stat='identity') +
  scale_fill_manual(values=b5_pal) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=std_pal) +
  my_theme2() +
  facet_wrap(~sample) +
  guides(fill='none') +
  labs(y='% of participants')
```

### Correlations between parameters

set up data

```{r}
attr.nest = attr0 %>%
  filter(version == 'chill') %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain,parameter,mean) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  nest() 
```

Functions for creating the correlation matrices

```{r}
get_cor = function(d){
  cr = cor(d$location,d$strength, use='pairwise.complete.obs')
  return(cr)
}

get_cormat = function(d){
  #correlations betwen strengths
  str = d %>%
    mutate(domain = factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
        arrange(domain) %>%
    filter(parameter == 'strength') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=domain,values_from=mean) %>%
    select(-SID,-parameter) %>%
    cor(use='pairwise.complete.obs')
  
  #correlations between locations
  loc = d %>%
    mutate(domain = factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
        arrange(domain) %>%
    filter(parameter == 'location') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=domain,values_from=mean) %>%
    select(-SID,-parameter) %>%
    cor(use='pairwise.complete.obs')
  
  #strength ~ location
  cross = d %>%
    mutate(domain = factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
    arrange(domain) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=parameter,values_from=mean) %>%
    group_by(domain) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(cor = map(data,get_cor)) %>%
    mutate(cor = unlist(cor))
  
  #set up the final correlation matrix
  cross_diag = cross$cor

  final = str
  final[upper.tri(final)] <- loc[upper.tri(loc)]
  diag(final) <- cross_diag
  
  final.df = data.frame(final) %>%
    rownames_to_column() %>%
    mutate(across(-rowname,~round(.x,2)))
}

```

Generate the correlation matrices

```{r}
attr.cormats = attr.nest %>%
  mutate(cormat = map(data,get_cormat))
```

Export cormats

```{r}
cormat.list = list(
  'cpe' = attr.cormats$cormat[[1]]
  ,'dt' = attr.cormats$cormat[[2]]
  ,'pairs' = attr.cormats$cormat[[3]]
  ,'pp' = attr.cormats$cormat[[4]]
  ,'sc' = attr.cormats$cormat[[5]]
)
writexl::write_xlsx(cormat.list,'../04-results/tables/descriptives/correlation-matrices.xlsx')
```

## 02. Visualizing variability in attractor parameters (main manuscript)

### Trajectory plots

```{r }
all.univ.traj = attr %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c('strength','location')) %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain,parameter,mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from='parameter',values_from='mean') %>%
  clean_names()

traj = all.univ.traj%>%
  crossing(
    p_value = seq(0,10, .5)
  ) %>%
    filter(location <10) %>%
  mutate(dp = location + strength*p_value)

traj %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = p_value, y = dp,colour=domain)) + 
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = 0)
    , linetype = "dashed"
  ) + 
  geom_line(
    aes(group = SID)
    # ,colour=domain
    , linewidth = .25
    , alpha = .5
  ) +
  ylim(-10,10) +
  facet_grid(vars(sample),vars(domain)) +
  my_theme2() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  scale_colour_manual(values = b5_pal) +
  labs(x='Level of personality state',y='Change in personality state')
```

### Within-person variability

```{r}
attr %>%
  clean_names() %>%
    filter(parameter %in% c('strength','location')) %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain,parameter,mean) %>%
  filter(parameter == 'location') %>%
  # filter(mean > -4.5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=domain,y=mean,group=SID)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour=SID),size=1, position=position_dodge(width=0.1)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour=SID),linewidth=.1, alpha=0.5, position=position_dodge(width=0.1)) +
  my_theme2() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~sample) +
  labs(title='Individual attractor strength profiles (all participants)')

```
